title: Raga 336 Ascent
lyrics:
4. Raga 336 Ascent
Concept: North Indian classical raga wisdom blended with subtle electronic architecture — the sovereign conductor’s ascent.
Suno Prompt: Instrumental only. North Indian raga atmosphere featuring expressive sitar leads, intricate tabla grooves, tanpura drone, bansuri flute, and subtle modern synth pads with gentle arpeggios. Structure: 0:00 meditative drone and sitar introduction, 0:40 tabla enters and rhythm builds, 1:20 playful yet precise tabla-sitar interplay with light comedic rhythmic flourishes, 2:00 soaring melodic peak with flute and synth support, 2:45 graceful resolution back to drone with extended outro. Professional rich harmonic depth and spatial clarity. Calm yet ascending power. 336 Hz foundation. Showcases Suno’s ability to generate authentic microtonal raga phrasing and complex tabla patterns while integrating modern atmospheric layers seamlessly.
